data.name: Byran
data.long_meaning: In Greek, Byrán is derived from the root býrō meaning 'to bring' or 'to carry'. This name signifies a strong and courageous individual, one who brings strength and support to others. In the Bible, there is no direct connection to this name. However, it is a reminder of God's strength and faithfulness in our lives.
data.spiritual_meaning: A symbol of divine strength and support.
